posts.title: Art, AI and the Problem that Never Was
posts.description: Even the most perfect reproduction of a work of art is lacking in one element: Its presence in time and space, its unique existence at the place where it happens to be. — Walter Benjamin For around one month I worked on a side project with a simple premise: AI detectors guess from the final image, but whether a human made a picture is a fact about how it was made.
